title: Herdr Worktree Configuration
description: Global and repository-specific settings used by hwt.

agent.description: Command an agent orchestrator should start in the new worktree.

ticket_command.description: Argument vector used to create a ticket. hwt appends the task description as one argument and expects JSON containing a non-empty branchName string.

review_command.description: Argument vector launched in a review workspace. hwt shell-quotes every configured argument before asking Herdr to run it and never appends pull request metadata.

worktree_dir.description: Directory for worktrees. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

worktree_naming.description: Strategy used to derive the worktree directory name from its branch.

worktree_prefix.description: Prefix added to generated worktree directory names.

urls.description: Named absolute URL templates. Built-in placeholders are {repository}, {branch}, {sanitized_branch}, {worktree}, {hostname}, and {pr_number}; custom metadata placeholders may be dot-separated.

metadata.description: Static and command-backed custom metadata used by named URL templates.

values.description: Static string values. Dot-separated names are supported.

commands.description: Named argv commands run lazily without a shell. Each command returns one JSON object with string values, exposed below the command name.

files.description: File operations performed after creating a worktree.

copy.description: Repository-relative files or directories copied into new worktrees. String entries inherit the files defaults; object entries may override them. Missing sources are ignored. Use <global> in a project config to include global entries.

parallel.description: Override whether this entry participates in parallel copying. A false value makes this entry a scheduling barrier.

copy_on_write.description: Experimentally attempt a filesystem copy-on-write clone before falling back to a normal copy.

symlink.description: Symlink this path to the source checkout instead of copying it. Cannot be combined with copy_on_write.

parallel.description: Copy configured entries in parallel. Set to false to copy them sequentially.

copy_on_write.description: Experimentally attempt filesystem copy-on-write clones before falling back to normal copies.

post_create.description: Shell commands run in order from the new worktree root. Use <global> in a project config to include global commands.

ports.description: Stable per-worktree ports reserved in a machine-local registry.

services.description: Service names exposed as HWT_PORT_<NAME> variables.

local_dns.description: Opt-in HWT-owned dnsmasq and Caddy snippet generation for worktree service hostnames.

enabled.description: Register routes during create, copy, env, and remove lifecycle operations.

domain.description: Local suffix for generated hostnames. DNS syntax is checked by hwt.

reload.description: Optional argv command run after owned snippets change. Supports {caddyfile}, {dnsmasq}, and {state_dir}; no shell is used.

environment.description: Non-secret variables written to .env.worktree and supplied to post_create commands.
